objective: Port netty-example (io.netty.example: the runnable examples of every module) as one executable, Netty.NET.Example: Java names (case and the Async suffix may differ), the original structure and every original comment, and an explicit evidence-backed record for each CLR adaptation and each example that is not ported.

ownerDecisions: Project, folder and assembly names are the namespace root of the module (owner decision 2026-11-19, see docs/codec-base-porting.md): io.netty.example is Netty.NET.Example.

Each package segment is PascalCased; where the package's Java type names spell the segment, their casing is kept (helloworld HelloWorld, websocketx WebSocketx, socksproxy SocksProxy, portunification PortUnification, localecho LocalEcho, haproxy HAProxy, ipfilter IpFilter, securechat SecureChat, heartBeat HeartBeat, benchmarkserver BenchmarkServer, websocket WebSocket); otherwise only the first letter is capitalized (echo Echo, qotm Qotm, http2 Http2, dot Dot).

statusMeaning.verified: The example is ported with its structure and every original comment and runs as in Java (the module declares no JUnit test).
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the named CLR adaptations (review.scope), every original comment preserved.
statusMeaning.deprecated-not-ported: Not ported: the example serves a @Deprecated unit that is recorded as deprecated-not-ported in its module's manifest (deprecation.family.familyManifest).
statusMeaning.library-not-ported: Not ported: the example needs a Java library or JDK-only API without a BCL counterpart, recorded in its module's manifest (library.familyManifest).
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only documentation or metadata, recorded with its CLR counterpart instead of a placeholder file.

review.scope: main returns after the first connect as in Java (the event loop threads are foreground, DefaultThreadFactory non-daemon); connect() is internal Connect(), whose listener runs synchronously where the connect Task completes (the Task carries no channel); the anonymous ChannelInitializer is an ActionChannelInitializer whose delegate is initChannel.

@Sharable is [Sharable]; channelRead0 is protected as the abstract SimpleChannelInboundHandler.ChannelRead0 it overrides; currentTimeMillis is DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(); format %5d is {0,5}; eventLoop().schedule is ScheduleAsync with a TimeSpan; package-private members are internal.

A sealed class with the private constructor; System.getProperty is ExampleLauncher.GetProperty (the -Dname=value arguments) and Integer.parseInt int.Parse with the invariant culture; main is an async Main that awaits the BindAsync Task<IChannel> and the CloseFuture in place of sync(); shutdownGracefully() is a discarded ShutdownGracefullyAsync(); NioServerSocketChannel.class is Channel<NioServerSocketChannel>(); the anonymous ChannelInitializer is an ActionChannelInitializer whose delegate is initChannel.
@Sharable is [Sharable]; channelRead0 is protected as the abstract SimpleChannelInboundHandler.ChannelRead0 it overrides; printStackTrace() writes Exception.ToString() to Console.Error.

A static class (the private constructor of the final utility class); System.getProperty("ssl") is ExampleLauncher.GetProperty("ssl"), which reads the -Dssl argument of the launcher (Java system properties are not environment variables). CertificateBuilder/X509Bundle are the PkiTesting port; toKeyManagerFactory() is the SslStreamCertificateContext that SslContextBuilder.ForServer takes.
